name: alumniconnect
description: College-specific professional networking platform connecting students with verified alumni

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:memory: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:memory --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
